summary: Tested Multi-Part (MP-1..MP-6) parity end-to-end. Backend /api/engine/calculate-multi-part: 12/12 pytest pass (Matched Set default, GM override @ 40.00% exact, Individual mode per-item qtys, Purchased markup 0.40, Fulfillment markup 0.45, manufactured pipeline non-zero cost, set-sell decreases with volume, Per Job freight allocation present, Fulfillment excluded from freight, unauth blocked, no-bomItems edge). Frontend UI: MP toolbar toggle, badge counter, BOM strip + Component / Duplicate / Remove, Convert→Simple with 1 item, Convert refusal with >1 item, MP banner text + per-component breakdown table, Simple-mode regression (no MP banner / no BOM in Simple) ALL PASS. CRITICAL: Spin-Off (↗) crashes the entire React app due to spinOffOrigin being stored as an object {estNum,itemDesc} but rendered as raw {s.spinOffOrigin} in EstimateInfoSec.jsx. Preview PDF in MP mode shows 'No active quantities' and does not render the BOM listing header tokens (Sets / Per Set / Per/M Sets) when pricing is $0 — needs investigation with priced rows.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking spin-off (bom-spinoff-N) immediately crashes the entire app with React error: 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {estNum, itemDesc})'. The spun-off tab is created but never renders because EstimateInfoSec.jsx:19 renders `{s.spinOffOrigin}` directly while QuoteContext.jsx:430 stores it as `{estNum, itemDesc}`.

Preview Quote modal in Multi-Part mode shows 'No active quantities to display' and only one Item label — does not render the per-component BOM listing nor the 'Sets / Per Set / Per/M Sets' headers. Tested with valid dims (5x7) + qtys [500,1000,2500] + default board. Likely cascading from pricing being $0 (engine not pricing through UI for default board) — needs investigation. Backend MP calc DOES produce real pricing (verified in pytest), so the issue is in the UI/engine handoff or the PDF MP-branch condition.

With valid dims (5x7) + qtys 500/1000/2500 and default board (200· C · Kemi/Kraft), Quote Table rows render but SELL/EA, GM%, GM$, TOTAL, COST/MSF, FREIGHT are all $0.00 / 0.0%. Per-component breakdown row also empty. Hook-order warning emitted: 'React has detected a change in the order of Hooks called'. Banner renders correctly, the issue is downstream pricing display.

integration_issues.issue: useEngine hook should be routing to /api/engine/calculate-multi-part in MP mode, but the UI displays $0 across all priced rows. Backend endpoint is verified working via pytest (Manufactured component runs full pipeline against board 200/B/42# Kemi-Lite producing non-zero cost/sell). Likely the default board the UI selects (200 C Kemi/Kraft) does not match any approved sheet OR print/finishing fields aren't being submitted. Component-level Console warning about hook-order suggests a conditional hook somewhere in the MP render path.

action_items: FIX SPIN-OFF CRASH (CRITICAL): In QuoteContext.jsx:430 change `newState.spinOffOrigin = { estNum: cur.state.estNum, itemDesc: target.desc };` to a string, e.g. `newState.spinOffOrigin = `${cur.state.estNum || '—'} / ${target.desc || ''}`;` — OR — update EstimateInfoSec.jsx:19 to render `{s.spinOffOrigin.estNum} / {s.spinOffOrigin.itemDesc}` defensively. Without this fix the entire app whitescreens on every ↗ click in MP mode.

Investigate Quote Table $0 pricing in MP mode end-to-end: confirm useEngine is calling /api/engine/calculate-multi-part (network panel) and the response.slots[N] values are being mapped into perComponent rows. Also resolve the React hook-order warning in the MP render path (likely a conditional `useMemo` or `useEffect` placed inside a conditional branch — Rules of Hooks violation).

Multi-Part PDF preview: verify the `is_mp` branch in /app/backend/routes/pdf.py:_customer_pdf_html is fed a payload that includes `bomItems` + `meta` so it can produce the BOM listing table and Sets/Per Set headers. Currently in preview modal it falls back to the simple-item layout.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL: QuoteContext.jsx:430 stores spinOffOrigin as object {estNum,itemDesc} but EstimateInfoSec.jsx:19 renders it as raw React child. Either change the store shape to a string OR render explicit fields. This is a 100% repro crash.

engine_routes.py calculate-multi-part: clean, mirrors legacy semantics. Matched-Set override uses `job_sell = job_cost / (1 - margin)` formula — verified produces exact 40.00% GM%. Purchased & Fulfillment branches correctly compute cost_pc/sell_pc and respect the per-slot purCostByQty dict pattern. Fulfillment excluded from job-freight allocation as expected.
Hook-order warning suggests Rules-of-Hooks violation somewhere in MP-aware render path (likely QuoteTableSec or useEngine). Address before shipping — these eventually cause silent state corruption.
Convert→Simple correctly refuses with >1 items (stayed in MP·2) — toast not visually verified but state did not flip.

Backend pytest covers happy paths only. Recommend adding: (a) empty pricingMode (defaults to Matched Set), (b) `setMarginOverride=true` with one Purchased+one Fulfillment to verify override only affects job_sell math, not per-component pricing, (c) negative qtys edge case.

After that fix re-test the spin-off → new tab flow + state isolation across the spun-off tab.
rca of the issue: Spin-off crash root cause: In /app/frontend/src/context/QuoteContext.jsx line 430 the spinOffBomItem callback stores `newState.spinOffOrigin = { estNum: cur.state.estNum, itemDesc: target.desc }` — an OBJECT. Then in /app/frontend/src/components/spot/EstimateInfoSec.jsx line 19 the header label renders `🔗 From: {s.spinOffOrigin}` interpolating the object as a React child, which React rejects (objects aren't valid children). The defaults.js sets spinOffOrigin=null so existing tabs are fine, but the moment any tab gets a non-null object value, it crashes on first render. Reproduction: (1) login admin, (2) click '→ Multi-Part', (3) click + Component once (now 2 items), (4) click ↗ on Item 2 → red screen. Mitigation (smallest patch): change line 430 to `newState.spinOffOrigin = (cur.state.estNum ? cur.state.estNum + ' · ' : '') + (target.desc || 'Untitled');` OR update EstimateInfoSec.jsx to render `{s.spinOffOrigin?.itemDesc || s.spinOffOrigin}` defensively (handles both legacy string and new object shape).
